# 8214 - TRI-STATE dual 4-line to 1-line data selector/multiplexer

Package DIP-16 · family 8000 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8214.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8214.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 49 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![8214 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8214.png) | ![8214 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8214.png) | ![8214 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8214.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | G1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 7; when not enabled: float |
| 2 | B | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1C3 | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | 1C2 | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | 1C1 | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | 1C0 | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | Y1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G1 |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | Y2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G2 |
| 10 | 2C0 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | 2C1 | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | 2C2 | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | 2C3 | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | A | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | G2 | enable | low |  | controls pins 9; when not enabled: float |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | Y1 = (B'A' AND 1C0) OR (B'A AND 1C1) OR (BA' AND 1C2) OR (BA AND 1C3) when G1'; Z when G1 high | Y1 gives the 1C input picked by B,A (true data) while G1 is low; floats while G1 is high. |
| 9 | Y2 = (B'A' AND 2C0) OR (B'A AND 2C1) OR (BA' AND 2C2) OR (BA AND 2C3) when G2'; Z when G2 high | Same for section 2 with G2. |

## Not known

- No minimum delays printed.

## Notes

Datasheet: three-state pin equivalent of 74153.
